pairs.target: yòu guò yírì , lún dào tǎ wéi dìèrshíèrcì gùdìng liànxí , chuāng biān de guāng hái méi yí dào jià jiǎo , tā biàn kànjiàn wéi lǎoshī nálái yìbǎ báo mù chǐ .
pairs.english: Another day passed, bringing Tavi's twenty-second fixed practice slot; before the window light reached the rack's foot, he then saw Teacher Vey bring a thin wooden ruler.
pairs.hanzi: 又过一日，轮到塔维第二十二次固定练习，窗边的光还没移到架脚，他便看见维老师拿来一把薄木尺。

pairs.target: chǐ búshì gěi tā liáng shǒu de , sòng yuǎn jiāng tā héng fàngzài liǎngzhī tiě jiàn pángbiān , shuō jīnrì yào ràng tā kànqīng , shǒu líkāi yǐhòu , jiūjìng háiyǒu méiyǒu dōngxī liúxià .
pairs.english: The ruler was not for measuring his hands; Song Yuan laid it crosswise beside the two iron pieces, saying today he should see clearly whether anything actually remained after his hands left.
pairs.hanzi: 尺不是给他量手的，宋远将它横放在两只铁件旁边，说今日要让他看清，手离开以后，究竟还有没有东西留下。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi yǐqián zài táishàng liúzhù guò nà yìxiǎo duàn biànhuà , tīngdào zhèlǐ réng yǒuxiē xīn rè , dài liǎngzhī mù tuō gè huí yuánchù , tā cái fāxiànzìjǐ yǐ xiān dīngzhù le yòubiān .
pairs.english: Tavi had retained that brief change on the bench before, and hearing this still stirred his hopes; only when both wooden carriers were back in their places did he notice he was already watching the right side first.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维以前在台上留住过那一小段变化，听到这里仍有些心热，待两只木托各回原处，他才发现自己已先盯住了右边。

pairs.target: tā huàn le zuò xiàng , zuǒ xī liúzài zhuō wài , liǎng zhǎng xiān kōng zhe zǒuyíbiàn , zhǐjié méiyǒu pèngdào mù yán , cái jiāng xiùkǒu chóngxīn juǎn hǎo .
pairs.english: He changed his seated angle, keeping his left knee outside the table; first empty palms rehearsed the route once, his knuckles missing the wooden edges, before he rolled his cuffs again.
pairs.hanzi: 他换了坐向，左膝留在桌外，两掌先空着走一遍，指节没有碰到木沿，才将袖口重新卷好。

pairs.target: yuánlái nà yíduì zhěng tiě dōu zài , wéi lǎoshī zhú chù chákàn luǒ miàn hé qiǎn cáo , zài gěi liǎngbiān gè ānshàng qīngzài , xiànwèi mùkuài yǔ xiàmiàn de ruǎndiàn yě méiyǒu chè .
pairs.english: The original pair of whole iron pieces were both there; Teacher Vey inspected each bare patch and shallow groove, then fitted light loads on either side; the wooden stops and padding below had not been removed either.
pairs.hanzi: 原来那一对整铁都在，维老师逐处查看裸面和浅槽，再给两边各安上轻载，限位木块与下面的软垫也没有撤。

pairs.target: duǎnshéng sōng zhe , mù tuō shǐzhōng yóu ǎi jià chéng zhù , tǎ wéi búbì tíqǐ tāmen , yě búyòng biān tuì biān zhǎohuí shǒu de dìfāng .
pairs.english: The short cords were slack, the wooden carriers supported throughout by the low rack; Tavi need not lift them, nor retreat while seeking where to put his hands back.
pairs.hanzi: 短绳松着，木托始终由矮架承住，塔维不必提起它们，也不用边退边找回手的地方。

pairs.target: liǎngbiān zài yuánzhuàng xià gè shòu yícì qīngyā , wéi lǎoshī ràng tā xiān kàn liǎngchù jìhào , suíhòu cái jiào tā jiāng dèngzi nuó jìn yìdiǎn .
pairs.english: Both sides each took one light press in their normal state; Teacher Vey had him first look at the two marks, then asked him to move the stool a little closer.
pairs.hanzi: 两边在原状下各受一次轻压，维老师让他先看两处记号，随后才叫他将凳子挪近一点。

pairs.target: sòng yuǎn méiyǒu tì tā shǔ , zhǐ wèn ruò shǒu huílái shí zhǐ xiān pèngdào yìbiān , lìngyìzhī shǒu yào qù nǎlǐ , tǎ wéi yòng kōng zhe de shǒuzhǐ gěi tā kàn .
pairs.english: Song Yuan did not count for him, only asked where the other hand should go if one side alone was touched first on the return; Tavi showed him with free fingers.
pairs.hanzi: 宋远没有替他数，只问若手回来时只先碰到一边，另一只手要去哪里，塔维用空着的手指给他看。

pairs.target: děng liǎng zhǎng dōu tiē wěn , tā cái yánzhe shúxī de fāngxiàng jiè le yìdiǎn , zuǒbiān zài qīngzài xià duō ràngkāi yìxiē , yòubiān nà yìdiǎn biànhuà què yào còujìn cái rènde qīng .
pairs.english: Only once both palms were firmly in contact did he make a small exchange in the familiar direction; the left yielded a little more under the light load, but he had to lean closer to make out that tiny change on the right.
pairs.hanzi: 等两掌都贴稳，他才沿着熟悉的方向借了一点，左边在轻载下多让开一些，右边那一点变化却要凑近才认得清。

pairs.target: zhè búshì ná zuǒbiān ràngkāi de jùlí qù yāoqiú yòubiān , wéi lǎoshī réng gè kàn gè de jìhào , diǎntóu yǐhòu , tǎ wéi cái huǎnhuǎn táiqǐ liǎng zhǎng .
pairs.english: This did not mean requiring the right to match the left's yielding distance; Teacher Vey still checked each side's own mark, and only after her nod did Tavi slowly raise both palms.
pairs.hanzi: 这不是拿左边让开的距离去要求右边，维老师仍各看各的记号，点头以后，塔维才缓缓抬起两掌。

pairs.target: tā méiyǒu xiān xiāodiào nà diǎn jièlái de biànhuà , shǒu yě bú qù wò mù yán , zuǒyòu zhǎngxīn zhǐ shēng dào lí luǒ miàn hěn jìn de dìfāng , zhǔnbèi yìtóng luò huí .
pairs.english: He did not first cancel that exchanged change; his hands would not grip the wooden edges either; both palms rose only a short distance above the bare patches, ready to return together.
pairs.hanzi: 他没有先消掉那点借来的变化，手也不去握木沿，左右掌心只升到离裸面很近的地方，准备一同落回。

pairs.target: tā kànjiàn zuǒbiān de xiàn sìhū hái piān zhe , xīnlǐ gāng shēngchū liúzhù le de niàntou , yòubiān nà dào xìfèng yǐjīng huíqù , zuǒbiān yě gēnzhe fùyuán .
pairs.english: He saw the line on the left apparently still displaced; just as a thought of retaining it arose in his mind, that fine gap on the right had already returned, and the left followed back to normal too.
pairs.hanzi: 他看见左边的线似乎还偏着，心里刚生出留住了的念头，右边那道细缝已经回去，左边也跟着复原。

pairs.target: liǎng zhǎng luò huí shí , wéi lǎoshī shuō xiān bié zài jiè , děng tā zhú biān chá guò , tǎ wéi cái bǎ shuāngshǒu yíkāi , sòng yuǎn jiāng qīngzài xièxiàlái .
pairs.english: When both palms returned, Teacher Vey told him not to make another exchange yet; only after she checked each side Tavi did move both hands away; Song Yuan removed the light loads.
pairs.hanzi: 两掌落回时，维老师说先别再借，等她逐边查过，塔维才把双手移开，宋远将轻载卸下来。

pairs.target: tā de shǒuzhǐ qīngchǔ , yǎnlǐ méiyǒu fāsuān , kě fāngcái nà yìdiǎn rèwàng luòde tài kuài , tā dītóu kàn zhǎngxīn , jìng juéde zìjǐ shì gāng pèngshàng qù jiù shōu le huílái .
pairs.english: His fingers were clear, with no ache in his eyes, but those brief hopes had sunk too quickly; he looked down at his palms and almost felt he had barely touched before pulling back.
pairs.hanzi: 他的手指清楚，眼里没有发酸，可方才那一点热望落得太快，他低头看掌心，竟觉得自己是刚碰上去就收了回来。

pairs.target: " táishàng míngmíng yǒu guò . "
pairs.english: “But it did happen on the bench.”
pairs.hanzi: “台上明明有过。”

pairs.target: huà chūkǒu , tā zìjǐ yě tīng chū shì zài zhēng , sòng yuǎn méiyǒu shuō nà búsuàn , zhǐ jiāng liǎnggè mù tuō zhījiān de kòng chù zhǐ gěi tā kàn , ràng tā zài xiǎngxiǎng gāngcái kàn de shì nǎ yìbiān .
pairs.english: As the words came out, he himself heard the protest too; Song Yuan did not dismiss it, only pointed out the space between the two wooden carriers to him, asking him to look and think again about which side he had watched just now.
pairs.hanzi: 话出口，他自己也听出是在争，宋远没有说那不算，只将两个木托之间的空处指给他看，让他再想想刚才看的是哪一边。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi běn xiǎng shuō liǎngbiān dōu kàn le , tíng le yíhuìer , cái chéngrèn xiān kàn zuǒbiān , děng xiǎngrèn yòubiān shí , shǒu yǐjīng wǎngxiàzǒu .
pairs.english: Tavi had meant to say he watched both sides, but after pausing a moment admitted he looked left first; when he tried to identify the right, his hands were already moving down.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维本想说两边都看了，停了一会儿，才承认先看左边，等想认右边时，手已经往下走。

pairs.target: wéi lǎoshī jiāng zhǐ nuó jìn , zhǐ xiěxià lí zhǎng hòu wèi jiàn kěyòng de liúzhù , méiyǒu tì tā tiān yìhuí chéng le , yě méiyǒu xiěchéng cóngqián nàxiē quán búzuòshù .
pairs.english: Teacher Vey brought the paper closer, only writing that they observed no usable retention after the palms left; she neither added one success for him nor said that all the earlier work did not count.
pairs.hanzi: 维老师将纸挪近，只写下离掌后未见可用的留驻，没有替他添一回成了，也没有写成从前那些全不作数。

pairs.target: tā wèn shìbushì tái de tàimàn , tā shuō jīnrì hái fēnbùqīng , búzài shàng zàichóng shì , xiān bǎ kànjiàn de hé cāi de fēnkāi , xiàhuí cái zhīdào gāi chá nǎ yíchù .
pairs.english: He asked whether he had lifted too slowly; she said they could not distinguish that today, so there would be no more loading to retry; first separate the observations and guesses, to know what spot to check next time.
pairs.hanzi: 他问是不是抬得太慢，她说今日还分不清，不再上载重试，先把看见的和猜的分开，下回才知道该查哪一处。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi xiǎng bǎ zhǐ shàng de zì jǐ duǎn yìxiē , bǐjiān tíng le bànshǎng , zuìzhōng háishì zhào tā dehuà jì le , zuǒbiān xiàntiáo nà yíxià yě lìng huà zài pángbiān .
pairs.english: Tavi wanted to squeeze the writing on the paper a little shorter; his pen paused for a long moment, but in the end he recorded according to her words, also separately sketching that brief movement of the left line beside them.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维想把纸上的字挤短一些，笔尖停了半晌，最终还是照她的话记了，左边线条那一下也另画在旁边。

pairs.target: sòng yuǎn shōu hǎo tiě jiàn , jiào tā gē xiàbǐ xiē zhe , tā què wènqǐ táng ruì de nà yíduì , wéi lǎoshī shuō réng liúzài tā zhèlǐ , hái méiyǒu bǎ chá guò dāng xiūhǎo le .
pairs.english: Song Yuan put away the iron pieces and told him to put down the pen and rest; instead he asked about Tang Rui's pair; Teacher Vey said it still remained with her, and inspected did not yet mean repaired.
pairs.hanzi: 宋远收好铁件，叫他搁下笔歇着，他却问起唐芮的那一对，维老师说仍留在她这里，还没有把查过当修好了。

pairs.target: chuāngwài yǒurén tuō zhe yìzhāng jiù diànzi guòqù , bù jiǎo cā guò zhuān fèng , tǎ wéi táitóu cái kànjiàn liáng jiàoxí , yāojiān de hùdiàn shàngwèi jìjǐn .
pairs.english: Someone passed the window dragging an old mat, its cloth corner brushing the brick joints; Tavi looked up and only then saw Teacher Liang, his waist pad not yet tied tight.
pairs.hanzi: 窗外有人拖着一张旧垫子过去，布角擦过砖缝，塔维抬头才看见梁教习，腰间的护垫尚未系紧。

pairs.target: sòng yuǎngé chuāng jiàozhù tā , wèn míngrì shuōhǎo de nàchǎng hái zuò bu zuò , liáng jiàoxí jiāng diànzi dā shàng jiān , shuō zuò , bié yòu jiào zìjǐ zhǐ zǒu gěi xuéshēng kàn de nà yìdāo .
pairs.english: Song Yuan called him through the window, asking whether tomorrow's agreed bout was still on; Teacher Liang slung the mat over his shoulder, saying yes, but do not again have him perform only that one cut for students to watch.
pairs.hanzi: 宋远隔窗叫住他，问明日说好的那场还做不做，梁教习将垫子搭上肩，说做，别又叫自己只走给学生看的那一刀。

pairs.target: sòng yuǎn wèn tǎ wéi néng bunéng zuò pángbiān kàn , liáng jiàoxí kàn le yìyǎn tā de zuǒtuǐ , shuō dèngzi fàngdào shéng wài , biétì rènhérén jiǎn dōngxī .
pairs.english: Song Yuan asked if Tavi could sit nearby to watch; Teacher Liang glanced at his left leg and said put the stool outside the rope, and do not pick things up for anyone.
pairs.hanzi: 宋远问塔维能不能坐旁边看，梁教习看了一眼他的左腿，说凳子放到绳外，别替任何人捡东西。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi dāying hòu , liáng jiàoxí cái zǒu , jiù diànzi yǒu yìjiǎo tuō zài dìshàng , sòng yuǎn zhuī dào ménkǒu tíxǐng , tā huítóu shuō zhèhuìer zǒngsuàn yǒurén kěn kàn jiǎoxià le .
pairs.english: Only after Tavi agreed did Teacher Liang leave; the old mat had one corner dragging on the ground, and Song Yuan went to the door to warn him; he turned back, saying at this moment at last someone was willing to look at his feet now.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维答应后，梁教习才走，旧垫子有一角拖在地上，宋远追到门口提醒，他回头说这会儿总算有人肯看脚下了。

pairs.target: liànxí jiān lǐ ānjìngxiàlái , tǎ wéi jiāng gāng xiě de zhǐ shōu jìn cè lǐ , méiyǒu zài qù mō kōng mù tuō , shǒuzhǐ què zài xī páng bǎ nàtiáo huílái de lù mànmàn zǒu le yíbiàn .
pairs.english: The practice room grew quiet; Tavi put the newly written sheet in his notebook, without touching the empty wooden carriers again; instead his fingers slowly traced that return route once beside his knee.
pairs.hanzi: 练习间里安静下来，塔维将刚写的纸收进册里，没有再去摸空木托，手指却在膝旁把那条回来的路慢慢走了一遍。

pairs.target: dào le ménbiān , tā wèn míngrì sòng yuǎn yě liú zhe jièlái de biànhuà me , sòng yuǎn shuō búyòng , nà yìchǎng liǎng zhǎng dōu tiēzhe , xiān kànqīng zìjǐ dàodǐ zài kàn shénme .
pairs.english: At the door he asked whether Song Yuan would retain an exchanged change tomorrow too; Song Yuan said no need, both palms would stay in contact in that bout; first be clear about what exactly he was watching.
pairs.hanzi: 到了门边，他问明日宋远也留着借来的变化么，宋远说不用，那一场两掌都贴着，先看清自己到底在看什么。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi yǒuxiē yìwài , yòu wǎng chuāngwài wàng , liáng jiàoxí yǐjīng jiāng diàn jiǎo tí qǐlái , zhèng zhāohū lìng yígè rén ràngkāi bāndōngxī de zhǎidào .
pairs.english: Tavi was a little surprised and looked out the window again; Teacher Liang had already lifted the mat’s corner, and was calling to another person to clear the narrow passage for moving things.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维有些意外，又往窗外望，梁教习已经将垫角提起来，正招呼另一个人让开搬东西的窄道。
